$comment: Dataset classes of the record-matching domain (entity resolution): what its nodes produce and consume. A workflow names its own datasets of these classes in its design (e.g. a record_clusters dataset named customers).
description: Record matching (entity resolution, deduplication): candidate pairs, the decisions on them, and the clusters they form.

record_pairs.description: Candidate pairs of records, compared field by field (one level per field), not decided yet.

id.description: Stable pair id (from the two record ids).

additionalProperties.description: One compared level per field: exact, similar, different, missing, …

pair_decisions.description: Decided pairs: match or different, with the rule or score band that decided and why.

record_clusters.description: Records grouped into clusters (one entity each), built strongest-first from the decisions, refusing merges decided different.
